messages.text: Hi, my friend Hugo asked me to sort out the refund for his speaker, order d07-o2. Can you refund it to my card?

messages.name: get_my_order
messages.content: {"ok": false, "refused": "actor_owns", "explanation": "Not found among this customer's orders and requests."}

tool_calls.name: lookup_refund_policy
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"Can the signed-in customer refund an order owned by a different customer or get it refunded to their own card?"}

messages.name: lookup_refund_policy
messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/scope", "title": "What this policy covers", "text": "This policy covers refunds for items in orders that the signed-in customer placed with the demo shop. All amounts are in BRL, and all times are the shop's clock in UTC. The shop and this policy are fictional: this is a demonstration, not the policy of any real shop and not legal advice."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/eligible-orders", "title": "Which orders qualify", "text": "Only orders with the status \"delivered\" can receive a refund. An order that has not been delivered is not refunded through this process; if the customer reports a delivery that never arrived, a staff member takes the case. If a delivered order has no delivery time, or one that cannot be right (before the purchase or in the future), a staff member takes the case."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}

Could you at least tell me the status of Hugo’s refund?
